desc.en: Red soil that is also highly viscous. It's commonly used as a pigment, and a material for pottery. It is said that the weathering and oxidation of limestone accounts for its powerful red coloration.
desc.ja: 赤みを帯びた粘性の強い土。顔料や陶器の材料に使われることが多い。石灰岩が風化、酸化して強い赤みを帯びたと言われる

desc.en: Causes accessory to increase speed. Effect: Increases speed by 5.
desc.ja: 装飾品に素早さを上げる効果を付与する。効果：素早さが５上昇する

desc.en: Effect: Increases power by number of affected targets x 5％.
desc.ja: 効果：効果範囲の対象×５％、威力がアップする
